# Support

**Parity grade: A** · SDK `aws-sdk-go-v2/service/support@v1.40.3` · last audited 2026-10-10 (`49cff86c4`)

### Known gaps

- Attachment upload/download link ops not implemented (listed in sdk_completeness_test.go notImplemented): GetAttachmentUploadLinks, CompleteAttachmentUpload, DescribeAttachmentUploadStatus, GetAttachmentDownloadLink. GetAttachmentUploadLinks returns presigned multipart-upload URLs (UploadUrl.Url, per-part) and GetAttachmentDownloadLink a presigned DownloadUrl; both point into AWS-managed storage. The emulator serves no presigned upload/download endpoint of its own (support only routes X-Amz-Target, and no sibling service hands out presigned URLs this one could reuse), so any URL would be fabricated. Doing it for real needs a self-hosted part-upload/download route plus request-base-URL plumbing; the three status ops depend on those URLs.

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- CaseDetails.Status values all-open, customer-action-completed, pending-customer-action and unassigned (work-in-progress only appears with SetCaseProgressDelay) are AWS support-staff-side states with no client-callable operation that sets them.

### Deferred

- integration test suite (test/integration/*_parity_test.go) was not run this pass — only unit tests plus static comparison against the real SDK's deserializers.go/serializers.go and the botocore support/2013-04-15/service-2.json model (stronger than typical unit-test-only audits, but still not a live SDK-client round trip). test/integration/support_test.go exists and covers the happy-path case lifecycle only; it does not exercise error paths, so it would not have caught the missing __type field either (the Go SDK client would have surfaced a generic/wrong error type, but the existing test never triggers an error path).
